map.输入「72,75,68,80」（单位 %）。\n数据量 n=4；总和 295.0: Enter "72,75,68,80" (in %). Count n=4; sum 295.00; mean 73.75; median (72+75)/2=73.50; min 68; max 80; range 12.00; variance 19.19; standard deviation 4.38. Reading: the mean 73.75% is close to the median 73.50%, indicating stable retention over the 4 months; a standard deviation of 4.38 percentage points is normal fluctuation and does not warrant overreacting to a single-month dip. If one month drops to 68 while the other three are 72-80, the range widens and the mean is pulled down; investigate that month's course or coach changes first.
map.方差/标准差用总体还是样本口径？: Should variance/standard deviation use the population or sample basis?
map.本工具用总体口径（除以 n），因为粘贴进来的这组数据就是你要分析的全部指标。样本: This tool uses the population basis (divide by n), because the pasted data set is the entire set of metrics you want to analyse. The sample basis (divide by n−1) is slightly larger and is used to infer a population from a sample; when the two are close the conclusions agree.
map.为什么均值和中位数都要看？: Why look at both the mean and the median?
map.均值受极端值影响大，中位数不易被极端值带偏。两者接近说明: The mean is strongly affected by extreme values, while the median is not easily skewed by them. Their closeness indicates the
